description: Using Azure Data Studio, connect to the local SQL Server instance and create a new view called 'vw_CustomerOrderSummary' in the AdventureWorks2022 database. The view should summarize customer orders by joining Sales.Customer, Person.Person, and Sales.SalesOrderHeader tables. The view should include: CustomerID, FirstName, LastName, TotalOrders (count of orders), TotalAmount (sum of TotalDue), and LastOrderDate. Execute the CREATE VIEW statement and verify the view was created by querying it.
